g.text: It was as easy as a problem
Talk it out, smack it around jajaja
You have a ton to be happy about, though.
I learned the hard way in Duviri that "fixing feelings" is sometimes the worse choice.
People understood that part of me
Will never let that sink in
But you've told me about what happens
I wish I could be different
But I am who I am
And I gave up apologizing for that
His heart is too cold as it is tho
What can we do to get your mind off things? Or would you prefer to stay in?
We can only hope he's playing the long game.
Or, we could go out and kill things
The only thing I hope for where that cabrón is involved
Is a long ride in an elevator
That's a mental image that cheers me up
Sit at the bar with M&V
Might get my mind off it
Take the pain out of my thoughts
By putting the pain into someone else's
